angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 416,029 km at 61.54 pc = 0.09 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 16.2487 +/- 0.0184 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 61.54 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.598 +/- 0.018 solar radii from Parc et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4342 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..81P/abstract): 416,029 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.587 +/- 0.013 solar masses from Parc et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-4342 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..81P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3866 +/- 92 K from Parc et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4342 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..81P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Parc et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4342 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..81P/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-4342.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.653, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4342 (pscomppars): spectral type M0 V, from Parc et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..81P/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-4342: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4342 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.26 dex, from Parc et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..81P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4342 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.12494, from Parc et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..81P/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4342 (pscomppars): rotation period 14.691 d, from Parc et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..81P/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
